name: Period Comparison
description: Builds the standard month / QTD / YTD / moving annual total comparison versus prior periods per group, with a fiscal year start of your choice, plus a monthly trend table.
introductoryText:
The comparison table that finance and trading packs typically start with, per group (region, channel, product), as at a reporting month:

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Month, Prior Month, Same Month Last Year | the reporting month and its comparators |
| QTD, Prior Year QTD | quarter to date (quarters follow the fiscal year) |
| YTD, Prior YTD | year to date, fiscal year starting in the month you choose (April for many UK organisations) |
| MAT, Prior MAT | moving annual total: the last 12 months, and the 12 before |
| Change and % Change | for month vs prior month, month vs last year, QTD, YTD and MAT |

A *Total* row is added when there are groups. The reporting month is the latest **complete** month in the data unless you set a date. A second output gives the monthly **trend table** per group: value, same month last year, % change, YTD cumulative, MAT and fiscal year label.

Input is transactions or daily / monthly totals with a date and a value; everything is summed by month first.

options.name: group_fields
options.title: Group by (optional)
options.description: One comparison per value, such as Region.

options.name: as_of
options.title: Reporting date (optional)
options.description: Any date in the reporting month, such as 2025-09-30. Empty = latest complete month in the data.

options.name: complete_months_only
options.title: Use the latest complete month
options.description: When no reporting date is set and the last month in the data is partial, report the month before.

blockOutputs.label: Comparison
blockOutputs.tooltip: Per group (and total): month, prior month, same month last year, QTD, YTD, MAT and their comparators, with changes.

blockOutputs.label: Monthly trend
blockOutputs.tooltip: Per group and month: value, same month last year, % change, YTD, MAT, fiscal year.
